1. Can a reference frame be chosen in which the magnetic induction is zero throughout the space surrounding a current-carrying conductor?
State the conductor charge-and-current model and the type of reference frame used in your discussion. If the stated conditions do not determine a unique conclusion, explain what additional conditions are needed.

4. Figure 127 shows a television receiving antenna. What can be concluded about the direction in which the magnetic induction vector of the wave emitted by the television station oscillates?
Base your judgment only on information actually given in the figure. If additional assumptions about the incident wave, propagation direction, or antenna matching are needed, distinguish those assumptions from the conclusions that follow from them.
